thread:
maria (Support): hey team — ACME reported being billed twice for a single user request after an app-level timeout. customer says the client showed a 504, then retried. invoice shows ~2x tokens for that session. attaching logs below.
liam (SRE): ok can you paste the original request id + headers? want to see if we saw duplicate ingress or a replay from the gateway.
jordan (Billing): flagged as high-priority for refunds if we confirm double-count. ledger shows two separate token entries ~3s apart.
maria (Support): request meta:
```
client_request_id: c_req_01F7X
customer_account: acme-corp
sdk_version: mobile-android-1.4.2
method: POST /v1/generate
content-length: 312
user-agent: ACME/1.2.3 okhttp/4.9.3
# NOTE: no X-Idempotency-Key header present
```
maria (Support): repro steps from customer: intermittent mobile network -> client receives 504 after 10s -> SDK calls retry with same body but mobile networking stack drops custom headers on follow-up attempt. they say header-stripping started after upgrading okhttp.
kai (Backend): ugh. our metering dedupe relies solely on X-Idempotency-Key TTL dedupe at gateway-level. if header missing we treat as fresh request.
liam (SRE): grep in gateway logs for body hash or request fingerprinting. replay-bot: detected 2 ingress events:
```
[2026-04-12T15:03:21Z] ingress_id=ing_9a3f client_req=c_req_01F7X fingerprint=f7b3a2 body_len=312 route=generate status=504 upstream_req_id=up_abc123
[2026-04-12T15:03:24Z] ingress_id=ing_9a40 client_req= REMOVED fingerprint=f7b3a2 body_len=312 route=generate status=202 upstream_req_id=up_def456
```
liam (SRE): note the fingerprint is identical, but second ingress lacked client_request_id header (redacted above). timestamps ~3s apart. upstream returned 504 then 202.
jordan (Billing): ledger entries tied to upstream_req_id (up_abc123 and up_def456) — two separate billing events. if we can correlate same fingerprint we can mark one as replay and refund.
kai (Backend): short-term fix: update gateway to compute a request fingerprint (sha256 of normalized body + route + model+short-timestamp-window) and dedupe within 10s window when no idempotency header. longer term: require SDK to include idempotency header and fail retry if header missing.
maria (Support): customer is asking what happened and wants refund for duplicated tokens. they also want guidance to avoid this in their app.
liam (SRE): i'll open an ops ticket to run a backfill to find similar fingerprints across last 48h and flag duplicates for billing review.
jordan (Billing): please include tenant id, fingerprint, timestamps, upstream ids and token counts. I'll hold refunds pending ops audit.
kai (Backend): also pushing a quick patch to gateway tonight: when fingerprint match & token_count_diff < 10000, auto-mark second event as replay and emit a billing-override metric for manual review.
maria (Support): suggested messaging to customer: "We're investigating an edge case where some mobile retries strip custom headers on network retries; we can submit a refund and recommend upgrading to mobile-android-1.4.3 which includes a retry-preserve-headers fix." anyone want to edit?
liam (SRE): :thumbsup: add the temporary workaround: enforce idempotency header in our mobile SDKs and log a clear warning when missing.
jordan (Billing): refund approved pending audit. record reason: client retry without idempotency header -> duplicate ledger entries.
kai (Backend): noted internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/replay-detection (will add mobile-note).
maria (Support): thanks — i'll reply to customer with ETA ~4h and ask for app logs. will follow up when ops run backfill. :white_check_mark:
jordan (Billing): looping in finance for ledger adjustment: @finance please expect a small batch of refund adjustments tied to replay-detection audit.
liam (SRE): next steps checklist:
- run backfill query for fingerprint=f7b3a2 and window +-30s (liam)
- apply gateway patch to dedupe when no idempotency header (kai)
- issue customer refund once audit confirms (jordan)
- update SDK docs + release patch (devex)
maria (Support): copied. closing loop after ops results.
replay-bot: automated note: created ticket OPS-4219 for backfill and BILL-987 for billing adjustments.
maria (Support): thanks everyone.
